senses.gloss:
r. 1st cl. (चोटति) and 10th cl. (चोटयति)
To wane, to become small, low or shallow.
r. 6th and 10th cls. (चुटति चोटति)
To cut, to pierce or divide;
(इ,) चुटि r. 1st cl. (चुंटति)
To become low or shallow.
r. 1st and 10th cls. (चुण्टति^1 चुण्टयति)
To cut, &c.; also चुट्ट and चुड.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20161212. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batches 309-312.

r. 10th cl. (चुट्टयति)
1 To become small, low or shallow, as a river, &c.
2 To collect.
